item.title: Version 2.1.5
item.description: • The chart over the waveforms now works on a mashup too: each song's chart follows along, cut to the arrangement the mashup plays, in the key it sounds in. • The chart band is taller, so the rhythm notes above a line of chords are no longer clipped. • When a chart's sections don't line up with the song, the red mark now sits on the section where they stop matching and says which one — "the second Intro, section 2 of 15". • A time signature change in the middle of a song: the marker on the chart is drawn as a small tab, the Nashville number chart writes the new signature over the bar where it changes, and the measures readout adds up.
